verdict.rationale: Svelte supports TypeScript in component script blocks via `lang="ts"`, and its own `sv check` CLI reports JavaScript/TypeScript compiler errors across a project. The team also maintains a VS Code extension, so first-party type checking of components exists. Nothing in the evidence, however, says that template markup expressions themselves are type-checked, which is the core of this story. missing for 10: explicit documentation that template expressions, props and bindings are type-checked at compile time, editor template type-checking details, independent hands-on corroboration.
